description: Vocal segmentation of dinle_2_vokal.wav: 7 verses x 4 lines, cut points, syllables with pitch, verse-6 repair data, noise floor
not_verified_by_ear: Everything here is measured by code and checked on spectrogram plots (cizim/*.png). Nobody listened to the audio.

schema.time_base: seconds on the timeline of dinle_2_vokal.wav (= dinle_2.mp3); 44.1 kHz mono

verses[].lines[].start / end: energy onset / decay of the sung line (10 ms RMS crossing sung_rms - 45 dB; inside a verse: around the energy dip between lines)
verses[].lines[].onset_strong: first instant the 10 ms RMS exceeds sung_rms - 20 dB (ignores faint pre-noise; 'start' can lie up to 120 ms earlier where a faint breath/noise precedes the first consonant: see summary.lines_with_faint_pre_noise)
verses[].lines[].first_vowel_onset: vowel_onset of the first syllable: the instant to put on the bar line
verses[].lines[].cut_in / cut_out: safe cut instants (energy minima). L1|L2 and L2|L3 share one instant; L3.cut_out and L4.cut_in are null because L3+L4 are one continuous chunk; cut_in_info / cut_out_info give level (dBFS) and quiet_window_ms of the dip
verses[].lines[].tail_end (L4): where the release/reverb tail reaches the noise floor; L4.cut_out = tail_end + 20 ms
verses[].lines[].ending (L4): what follows the last vowel; extra_voiced_sound flags a non-lyric after-sound

schema.verses[].chunks[]: the three pieces to cut per verse: [L1], [L2], [L3+L4]. fade_in_max_ms = start - cut_in and fade_out_max_ms = cut_out - end: keep fades inside these so they never touch the sung sound (some gaps between lines are only 5-15 ms wide)

syllables[].start / end: contiguous tiling of the line; boundary = end_boundary.t
syllables[].end_boundary.kind: dip = energy minimum in the consonant between the two vowels (reliable); spectral = no dip, largest spectral change (nasal release, glide, vowel-to-vowel); midpoint = no acoustic boundary, merged vowel split in the middle (flag)
syllables[].vowel_onset: first instant the 100-1000 Hz band (f0 + F1; 20 ms envelope) comes within 6 dB of its peak in the syllable: skips voiceless frication, bursts and voiced closures; equals the syllable start for sonorant onsets. Beat-alignment point (approximate, see summary.vowel_onset_spread_ms)
syllables[].nucleus / core_start / core_end: vowel peak and the voiced region within 6 dB of it
syllables[].f0_hz / f0_midi: median f0 of the vowel core (pyworld harvest, 150-700 Hz, 5 ms) = the sung pitch of the syllable
syllables[].f0_all_*: median over ALL voiced frames in [start,end) (includes consonant dips and scoops)
syllables[].voiced_ratio: voiced 5 ms frames / all frames in [start,end)
syllables[].flag: true when its start or end boundary was placed by rule

words[].flag: true when a boundary inside the word was placed by rule
words[].blind_check: result of the plain envelope-peak nuclei count (cross-check only)

summary.flag_meaning: a syllable boundary inside the word has NO acoustic evidence and was placed by rule (midpoint of the merged vowel). All cases are 'çift-li-ği' / 'Çift-li-ğin-de': the soft g between two identical vowels is one long [i:].
summary.blind_check_meaning: the plain method (peaks of the smoothed voiced-energy envelope inside the word) did not find the expected number of nuclei in these words; they were NOT split proportionally: boundaries come from the alignment-guided cues (end_boundary.kind) instead
other_defects: K3 L4: extra voiced sound after the last 'bak' at 41.388-41.590 s

noise_floor.interpretation: Between verses the stem sits at about the 16-bit quantisation floor (1 LSB = -90.3 dBFS); a few isolated blips (see gaps[].peak_dbfs) raise the pooled RMS. The stem is effectively gated: no audible band bleed and no long reverb tail in the gaps.

in_line_stop_closures.meaning: level of the stem inside voiceless stop closures WITHIN lines (the band was playing there in the original mix): an upper bound for instrument bleed at those instants

harmonic_to_interharmonic_db.meaning: steady vowels, 300-2500 Hz: harmonic peak vs level between harmonics; a rough indicator of breath + possible bleed/reverb UNDER the voice (cannot separate them)

noise_floor.unverified: bleed or reverb under the sung vowels themselves cannot be measured from the stem alone and was not checked by ear

verse6_repair.problem: verse 6, line 2: the singer sang 'ördekleri' (76.837-77.564 s) instead of 'köpekleri'
verse6_repair.plan: replace [front_cut .. splice_in_ordekleri] ('ördek' up to the /k/ closure) by [kopek_source_start .. splice_in_kopekler] ('Köpek' up to the /k/ closure) taken from line 3 of the same verse; keep the /k/ burst + 'leri' of 'ördekleri'

splice_in_kopekler.meaning: end of 'köpe' + first part of the /k/ closure: take source audio up to splice_t

splice_in_ordekleri.meaning: matching /k/ closure before 'leri': keep target audio from splice_t on

front_cut.note: 'de' runs straight into 'ör' (vowel to vowel, NO silence here): fade the end of 'de' out over about 15-25 ms ending at t, then leave a /k/ closure silence before the 'Kö' burst

verse6_repair.pitch_note: E4 = MIDI 64. 'Kö' is the first syllable of line 3 and is sung lower than the reciting tone (see kopek_part.syllables); in the 'dogal' variant the spliced 'kö' will therefore sit about 1.9 semitones under the surrounding E4 unless only that syllable is corrected

l4_comparison.score_formula: timing_ms/20 + |mean syllable peak diff| dB/1 + pitch_st(first 5 syllables)/0.3 + final_dev_from_C4_st/0.3 (lower is better)
l4_comparison.verse3_note: verse 3's own L4 ends with an extra voiced after-sound (lines[3].ending). Either cut it at cut_out_before_extra_sound (the word then ends in an unreleased k) or reuse another L4 / final 'bak'
l4_comparison.final_word_only_alternative: instead of the whole L4, only the last 'bak' can be replaced: cut at per_verse[].b_closure_before_final_bak.t in both verses (verse 6's closure is silent, the donors' closures are voiced at about -25..-35 dBFS, so use a 10 ms crossfade)
l4_comparison.verse6_problem: final 'bak' of verse 6 is on D4 (MIDI 62.11) instead of C4
l4_comparison.how_to_reuse: cut verse 6's chunk [L3+L4] at its own L3|L4 junction (lines[2].end) and continue with the donor's L4 from the donor's L3|L4 junction (lines[3].start) to its cut_out, with a short (about 10 ms) crossfade: neither junction is silent (see l3_l4_junction.level_dbfs)
